capture_symbol_pool: Union of the 346 existing SM1 eligible symbols plus SPY; capture union is not a common future-completeness selection rule
overlap_check: All January 2023 symbol-session closes must equal retained SM1 cache; no silent vintage splice
factor_units: Percent in source converted to decimal once; ignore annual rows and dates outside 2022-04 through 2025-10
factor_vintage: Current retrospective French CIZ source, not historical publication snapshot
factor_lag: Regression ends in calendar month immediately before formation month; full calendar month lag is a DX27 assumption, not proof of release availability
regression: OLS monthly stock total-return proxy minus RF on intercept, Mkt-RF, SMB, HML; exact 36 consecutive months, no imputation or regularization
rank_adjusted_return: u=y-beta_M*MktRF-beta_S*SMB-beta_H*HML; estimated intercept retained in fit but NOT subtracted when forming u; u=alpha+OLS_error
rank_window: Last 11 regression months, ending formation_month minus 1; prior 2-12 stock-return convention retained
score: sum(last_11_u)/sample_standard_deviation(last_11_u); additive aggregation and ddof=1 are explicit DX27 arithmetic conventions; no compounding fictitious investable residuals
matched_pool: For each original formation separately: original high-beta eligible names with complete 36 monthly stock returns, valid factors/full-rank OLS and nonzero score-window dispersion; shared by all matched selectors
matched_relative: Retain original archived sector-relative score and original peer pool; only restrict candidate list
primary: 5bp matched_residual minus matched_ordinary unannualized return and difference in gross positive stock holding-interval frequency; observed drawdown also report
controls: Parent ordinary isolates additional-history sample restriction; matched relative is context; do not call same-gross portfolios risk matched
execution: Parent SM1 ten 10% slots, max two per sector, monthly fixed targets entered at second later benchmark close; remainder zero-interest cash; no risk-budget overlay, leverage or shorting
missing_held_price: HALT_NO_FULL_PERIOD_RETURN; no excluding names using subsequent quote completeness
statistics: gross stock interval positive count, not actual trade wins or independent trials
matched feature coverage and rejection reasons
sample: Same original eight formations April-November 2025 and marks through December 31; not an independent holdout
